name: MineMeBoostXray
description: MineMenu, MineBoost and MineXray in one mod. Right Shift opens a menu with three tabs: MineMenu (80+ singleplayer cheats on 7 pages: build tools, fun events, utility HUD, creators, morph...), MineBoost (FPS boost: Render Scale, Lag Doctor, Intel iGPU preset, Idle Mode, A/B test; works alongside Sodium and friends) and MineXray (X-ray for singleplayer, and servers if you allow it: Classic X-Ray, Ore ESP with fused veins, Cave Finder, Fluid View, Lava Warning, Block ESP, Entity ESP, block editor, presets and a vein scanner). Ctrl+K opens the Command Palette. In English and Portuguese (Portugal).
